Review Questions 
1 . The nurse is caring for a client with a small bowel obstruction. The client asks why they are experiencing 
vomiting of stool. What response by the nurse is appropriate? 
76     4 • Chapter Summary
Access for free at openstax.org

a. The gastrointestinal tract is one long tube, so a blockage will cause contents to move backward. 
b. The pyloric valve prevents stool from flowing into the stomach when the intestines are blocked. 
c. Peristaltic movement prevents the backflow of contents when the intestines are blocked. 
d. Obstruction of the small bowel will not cause vomiting of stool.
